messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

message.content: At 10 kPa (≈0.1 atm) water’s melting/freezing temperature is essentially unchanged from its normal 0 °C value – only a few thousandths of a degree lower. In practice you can treat it as **0 °C** (the exact value is roughly –0.005 °C).
